title: Clear Fund Board Meeting
description: Fall board meeting reviewing organizational progress and initiatives. Discussion of strategic priorities and operational updates.

attachments.label: Minutes
attachments.title: Minutes
attachments.text: Minutes for the October 15, 2015 meeting of the Clear Fund (aka GiveWell) Board of Directors 00:00:00 Meeting called to order. 01:01:35 Elie provides the Board with an update on GiveWell's work and expected money moved for 2015.  06:35:00 Board discusses GiveWell's relationship to the Effective Altruist movement. 27:45:00 Board discusses relationship between GiveWell and the Open Philanthropy Project. 59:58:00 The meeting is adjourned.
